**Relevant information:** In the earlier conversation about DIY home decor with recycled materials (item 1, dated 2023-05-20), the assistant listed the "Newspaper Flower Vase" project: "Roll up strips of newspaper to create a sturdy base, then weave them together to make a vase. Seal the vase with Mod Podge or another sealant to make it water-resistant."

**Reasoning:** The sealant named for the newspaper flower vase was Mod Podge. The assistant also said "or another sealant," so other sealants would work too. The only one named specifically was Mod Podge.

**Answer:** I recommended Mod Podge, which makes the vase water-resistant. Another sealant would work as well.
